programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) / Post Graduate Programme in Management (PGP)
programs.feeNote: Batch 2026-28 'Total Fee (A)' (admission, tuition, infrastructure) for two years; deposits and alumni fee extra (total INR 20,75,000), mess at actuals. Same fee for MBA and MBA-ABM.

feeSource.title: IIM Lucknow - Fee Structure PGP-I & II for Batch 2026-2028 (listed as 'Fee structure- PGP & PGP ABM, Batch of 2026 - 2028')
feeSource.quote: Fee Structure - PGP-I & II for Batch 2026-2028 ... Total Fee (A): PGP-I (2026-2027) 1075000; PGP-II (2027-2028) 975000 [Admission Fee 100000 + Tuition Fee 630000+630000 + Infrastructure Fee 345000+345000]; Total Fee (A + B) 1095000 / 980000 incl. Refundable Deposits 20000 and Alumni Membership Fee 5000. Mess Charges will be payable on actual basis.
